label: Country Posters — poster wall
note: The printable poster wall pane of the Country Posters element (country-posters-mfe composes it); also embeddable alone. profile-config `countries` (ISO-3 list or {code,name,count} records) or `region` (a WAGF region label) shows only those, flat, under a host's own region heading (DX Life's /regions, 2026-09-30); without them the wall is unchanged.
